blocks.content: Congratulations on reaching the final chapter of this course!
By this point, you've become well-acquainted with how JS works in browsers. Now, you'll put everything you've learned into practice by working on two hands-on projects:
In this chapter, you'll focus solely on completing the Tic-Tac-Toe game. In the next chapter, you'll work on building the digital world clock project.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
